description: Every money helper gains a leading ctx parameter. The diff updates ten callers across ten directories; src/reports/monthly.report.js (untouched) still calls roundHalfEven(total) and fromMinorUnits(...), so the amount lands in ctx and ctx.exponent throws on a number.

expect.lesson: When a function gains, loses or reorders a parameter, check every call site in files the diff does not touch for the old arity or order; a shifted argument is a silent wrong value, not a crash.
